name: Isle of Wight
appliesTo: We will continue to set term and holiday dates for community and voluntary controlled schools.
academyNote: Academies, private and independent schools have the freedom to determine and set their own term dates/holidays and inset days.

localFacts.fact: Island schools take a two-week October half term: 19 October to 30 October 2026, as in 2025 (20 to 31 October 2025).
The summer term runs late to make up for the longer October break: it ends on Wednesday 28 July 2027 (27 July 2026 the year before).
Schools can take up to five development day closures during an academic year, which may change the start or end date of any school term.
The council publishes each school's development day closures on its term dates page, including academies' dates where known.
For 2025-26 the council listed some schools taking a one-week October half term and finishing for the summer a week earlier.
Each school is responsible for telling parents, meal providers and transport about its development day closures.

2026-27.insetNote: Schools can take up to five development day closures during an academic year; the council publishes them school by school.
